checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 70% (about ₹4,512cr or more against FY26's ₹2,654cr), the guidance raised from 50% on the 14 August call
checkpoints.ifMet: The new Ratlam capacity and dealer additions are selling through; the raised guide holds
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's 125% jump was a one-off season or subsidy rush; growth is slowing

checkpoints.text: EBITDA margin of at least 18% in Q2 FY27, in line with management's 18–19% 'sustainable to improve' guidance (the company's EBITDA excludes other income, so it matches Screener's operating margin: 18.9% in Q1)
checkpoints.ifMet: The in-house DCR cells are protecting the margin even as it passes savings to customers
checkpoints.ifMissed: Price cuts to win volume or falling panel prices are eating the margin

checkpoints.text: The 2 GWh lithium-ion battery line at Ratlam commissioned in Q2 FY27, as promised on the call (it was already pushed back from earlier plans)
checkpoints.ifMet: Ratlam becomes a full panel-inverter-battery site; less reliance on bought-in batteries after the Bawal fire
checkpoints.ifMissed: A second delay on the battery line; execution is stretching

checkpoints.text: Insurance claim for the May 2026 Bawal battery-plant fire (₹143.6cr written off in Q1) settled in full by March 2027, as management expects
checkpoints.ifMet: The Q1 write-off reverses and the lost profit comes back as cash
checkpoints.ifMissed: Part of the fire loss is permanent; reported profit and cash stay lower

checkpoints.text: Sakti Unit 1 (600 MW), shut since a boiler accident on 14 April 2026, back in operation by the end of Q2 FY27 (management said end-September or the first week of October; revival was 26% done in late July)
checkpoints.ifMet: The quarter's ₹256cr Sakti hit starts to reverse from Q3
checkpoints.ifMissed: Another quarter of lost Sakti output and EBITDA; debt cover stays stretched

checkpoints.text: Sakti Unit 2 (about 600 MW) commissioned by Q4 FY27, taking capacity from 4,180 MW to 4,780 MW (₹1,745cr of its ₹5,209cr budget still to spend at June)
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth in volume is real and the project spending ends
checkpoints.ifMissed: Spending continues without earnings; the leverage case weakens

checkpoints.text: More of the uncontracted Meenakshi and Sakti capacity tied up at 'respectable' rates during FY27, lifting the contracted share above the 74% of sales at June (management gave no figure)
checkpoints.ifMet: Less exposure to power-exchange prices; steadier earnings
checkpoints.ifMissed: Earnings stay tied to merchant prices and imported-coal costs

checkpoints.text: Another 250–300 MW of renewable capacity commissioned in Q2 FY27, as the CEO guided on 27 August (mostly state-grid projects already nearly complete); no revenue or profit guidance was given
checkpoints.ifMet: Execution stays on the pace needed for 2 GW this year
checkpoints.ifMissed: First slip against its own commissioning plan

checkpoints.text: Power purchase agreements signed for the SECI round-the-clock ('thermal mimic') award (230 MW contracted, about 870 MW plus 2.2 GWh of batteries, ₹5.26 a unit) and the 350 MW of FDRE and 150 MW hybrid capacity said to be in advanced talks, within 'the next few months'
checkpoints.ifMet: Awarded-but-unsigned capacity (about 5 GW) starts converting into contracted growth
checkpoints.ifMissed: The pipeline stays on paper; growth beyond FY28 is less certain

checkpoints.text: About 2 GW commissioned in FY27, taking operating capacity to about 4 GW by March 2027, which management says carries a run-rate EBITDA of ₹2,700–2,750cr (₹1,620cr on 2,575 MW in August); capex to reach about ₹22,000cr
checkpoints.ifMet: Run-rate profit nearly doubles within the year; the high price starts to make sense
checkpoints.ifMissed: Earnings growth lags the debt being taken on

checkpoints.text: About 4.5 GWh of battery storage installed by June 2027 (about 0.5 GWh at August 2026; all 4.5 GWh ordered from Envision), on the way to 10 GWh by March 2028
checkpoints.ifMet: Firm-power contracts can be met and spare batteries earn merchant income
checkpoints.ifMissed: Penalty risk on FDRE contracts that require evening and morning peak supply

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of about 60% at company level, as guided on 12 August (branded spirits 60–70%); on Screener's FY26 sales of ₹1,000cr that means about ₹1,600cr. Q1 grew only 17–18%, so H2 has to carry it.
checkpoints.ifMet: The capacity built in FY25–FY26 is turning into sales; the price would start to look reasonable
checkpoints.ifMissed: Guidance was too ambitious; the stock is priced for growth that did not come

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 23–24%, including sugar, on the company's own basis (it counts other income; Screener's FY26 operating margin was also 23%). Q1 was 18.5% on the company's basis and 17% on Screener's.
checkpoints.ifMet: The richer brand mix is offsetting the new staff and brand spending
checkpoints.ifMissed: Whistler and bulk alcohol are diluting the margin faster than Indri lifts it

checkpoints.text: ₹300–400cr of FY27 revenue from the new Chhattisgarh distillery (only about ₹5cr in Q1, after 15 days of output), reaching about 50% use of its 210 KLPD by March 2027, as reaffirmed on 12 August.
checkpoints.ifMet: The second plant is earning its keep and supports the 60% growth target
checkpoints.ifMissed: Ethanol orders and approvals are slower than planned; the plant adds cost before it adds profit

checkpoints.text: No increase in debt during FY27 (management said all operating cash would go into growth, with meaningful debt reduction from FY28); Screener shows ₹531cr of borrowings at March 2026.
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is being funded from its own cash despite the barrels it keeps filling
checkpoints.ifMissed: Ageing whisky stock keeps absorbing cash; the balance sheet keeps stretching

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 maize crushing of about 1.0–1.1 lakh tonnes (Q1 was 69,689 tonnes) as the doubled 1,650 tonne-a-day plant runs fully, as the CMD said on 17 August; no margin guidance was given.
checkpoints.ifMet: The new capacity is running and revenue should jump from Q1’s ₹202cr
checkpoints.ifMissed: Stabilising the doubled plant is taking longer; debt stays at its peak for longer

checkpoints.text: FY27 crushing of at least 4 lakh tonnes (2.65 lakh in FY26) with value-added products (liquid glucose, maltodextrin, dextrose, modified starches) at 20–22% of turnover, from 3% in FY26.
checkpoints.ifMet: The ₹664cr expansion is paying off and the product mix is richer
checkpoints.ifMissed: The expansion is under-used and the debt taken for it weighs on profit

checkpoints.text: Debt peaks in H1 and falls in H2 as maize stock is used up (management said working-capital debt usually drops to about 40% of its peak by Q4); net interest cost about ₹40cr in FY27. Net debt was ₹735cr at June 2026.
checkpoints.ifMet: The business moves from capex to cash generation, as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: Leverage stays above five times operating profit; the main risk in the card

checkpoints.text: Revenue growth of about 30% or more in Q2 FY27: management said on 1 September that the 30–44% growth across categories would continue and that H2 adds a further ₹150–200cr over H1.
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is broad-based, not just a hot-summer ice-cream quarter
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1 was flattered by the weak base and the summer; the 116x P/E has less support

checkpoints.text: EBITDA margin held near Q1’s 14.9% (Screener basis, which matches the company's here) as it passes on the Tamil Nadu milk procurement price rises with price increases after a 2–3 month lag; management expects about half a point a year of gain from scale.
checkpoints.ifMet: Pricing power is real despite costlier milk
checkpoints.ifMissed: Milk inflation is outrunning price increases; the margin story is weaker than claimed

checkpoints.text: H2 FY27 revenue ₹150–200cr above H1, with the new 120 t/day cheddar cheese plant ramping up and the IPO money (₹497cr) used to repay debt.
checkpoints.ifMet: The plan laid out at listing is on track; interest costs fall
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth is slowing after the IPO; the valuation looks stretched

checkpoints.text: High-value products (rolls, castings and special alloy grades) at 60% or more of revenue in Q2 FY27, with profit per tonne near Q1’s ₹13,500 — the two numbers management asked to be judged on (8 September); it guided no new melting capacity this year, so growth comes from mix.
checkpoints.ifMet: The mix shift keeps lifting profit faster than revenue
checkpoints.ifMissed: The mix story has stalled while the plant is full

checkpoints.text: About ₹80cr of capex in FY27 (₹5cr spent in Q1) on IPO-funded machining, solar and the new Unit 3 foundry, with the cash cycle held at 90–100 days on the company’s measure (Screener’s FY26 figure, 175 days, is much higher).
checkpoints.ifMet: Expansion stays funded from IPO money and profits without new debt
checkpoints.ifMissed: Stock keeps piling up and capex needs borrowing

checkpoints.text: Unit 3 (centrifugal casting for ICDP and high-speed-steel rolls, which India mostly imports) starts production in Q1 FY28, as said on 8 September; capex not yet disclosed.
checkpoints.ifMet: The next leg of growth arrives on time
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth stays limited to mix while the plant runs at 90%+

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of about 30% (about ₹135cr on FY26’s ₹104cr), as guided on 14 August; Q1 grew only 9%, blamed on summer seasonality.
checkpoints.ifMet: The new hubs are adding revenue as fast as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth has slowed after the IPO; the new hubs are not filling

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin back to about FY26’s level (36% consolidated, the same basis as Screener) by year end, after Q1 fell to 12.5% on a one-off ₹2.5cr AI-tool marketing push and hub start-up costs; management promised this on adjusted margins.
checkpoints.ifMet: Q1 was a one-off and the expansion is not diluting profit
checkpoints.ifMissed: New hubs and marketing are a lasting drag on margins

checkpoints.text: Ten new IVF hubs open in FY27 (South Extension opened 16 July; Gurgaon and Nagpur due by September), each breaking even within about three months, funded by ₹25cr of IPO money.
checkpoints.ifMet: The IPO money is being put to work on schedule
checkpoints.ifMissed: Expansion is slipping; the cash stays idle in deposits

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of about ₹2,080cr (24% growth), EBITDA ₹530cr and PAT ₹360cr, as the CFO guided on 4 August; management said it expects to beat these.
checkpoints.ifMet: The acquisitions and new beds are paying off on schedule
checkpoints.ifMissed: New hospitals are ramping slower than promised

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 26–27% excluding other income (the same basis as Screener), despite new hospitals starting at 10–12% and occupancy falling with added beds.
checkpoints.ifMet: Older hospitals carry the new ones, as claimed
checkpoints.ifMissed: Fast expansion is diluting profitability

checkpoints.text: 4,740 operating beds by March 2027 (3,960 in June; Rudrapur 330 beds from 2 August; Narela 200, Palam Vihar 100 and Zirakpur 150 due in November–December), funded without new debt.
checkpoints.ifMet: The capacity plan to 5,740 beds by FY28 is on track
checkpoints.ifMissed: Integration of acquisitions is slipping

checkpoints.text: Payer mix moving from 77% government schemes towards 70:30 within 12–18 months and debtor days down to 125–130 (129 at March 2026 on Screener).
checkpoints.ifMet: Less dependence on slow-paying government schemes; cash improves
checkpoints.ifMissed: Government schemes still dominate, keeping receivables high

checkpoints.text: Operating profit (EBITDA) at or above zero in Q2 FY27. Management gave no guidance, but said on 29 Sep that Q1 (a ₹14cr loss on Screener's basis) is the leanest quarter, that Q1's costs are the base for Q2, and that gross profit of about ₹55cr a quarter (₹43cr in Q1) breaks even at EBITDA before rent and interest on leases
checkpoints.ifMet: The four large stores opened in FY26 are starting to carry their costs
checkpoints.ifMissed: Even the busier festive quarter does not cover the cost base; losses continue

checkpoints.text: No new large experience centres in FY27 and bank borrowings (₹436cr at June 2026) falling, as management said on 29 Sep: costs are fixed after the FY26 expansion and debt should come down as the business earns operating profit (no numbers given)
checkpoints.ifMet: The cash drain is slowing and the IPO money is not being spent on another round of stores
checkpoints.ifMissed: More stores or more debt before the current ones pay; the loss-making model is still expanding

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue up at least 20% (₹1,914cr or more against ₹1,595cr), as management said on 7 Aug that demand had rebounded in June–July and a 'substantial jump' would show this quarter, on the way to 20% growth for the year
checkpoints.ifMet: The soft April–May was a blip; the 1.2 million-tonne year is on track
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's 10% volume growth was the trend, not the low point

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of at least 3.5%, management's 'steady state' guide on 7 Aug (Q1 was 3.26% after a ₹10cr inventory loss; the company's margin and Screener's are on the same basis here, as other income is negligible)
checkpoints.ifMet: Margin is moving towards the 4% medium-term aim
checkpoints.ifMissed: Steel price swings keep eating the thin margin

checkpoints.text: FY27 steel volume of 1.2 million tonnes (about 20% growth on FY26's 1 million) and non-steel revenue up about 25%, both reaffirmed on 7 Aug (Q1: 2.5 lakh tonnes, +10%; non-steel ₹165cr, +15%)
checkpoints.ifMet: The marketplace keeps taking share and the non-steel recovery is real
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth guidance was too high; the non-steel push is still stalling

checkpoints.text: About eight new fulfilment centres in FY27 (three added in Q1, about five more planned), with working capital kept under 30 days (27 days in Q1)
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is coming without tying up more cash
checkpoints.ifMissed: Expansion slows or needs more working capital

checkpoints.text: H1 FY27 revenue up about 30% (about ₹146cr or more against ₹112cr), in line with the roughly 30% FY27 growth the CFO said existing plants can deliver before the new plant (19 May)
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is holding even before the new plant
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth slowed from FY26's 57%; the main customer may be rolling out fewer stores

checkpoints.text: The 2.5 lakh sq ft Ambernath plant (about ₹90–95cr, IPO-funded) completed in Q3 FY27, as the CFO said on 19 May
checkpoints.ifMet: Capacity for the FY28 target is in place
checkpoints.ifMissed: Delay pushes back the FY28 growth step

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of about 30% (₹284cr or more against ₹218cr), as guided on 19 May
checkpoints.ifMet: On track for the FY28 target
checkpoints.ifMissed: The FY28 target of ₹400cr looks out of reach

checkpoints.text: FY28 revenue above ₹400cr and profit after tax above ₹100cr, the CFO's guidance on 19 May once the Ambernath plant runs; long-term profit margin about 25% (29% in FY26)
checkpoints.ifMet: The capacity step-up is filled with orders and the margin holds
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth depends on too few customers to fill the new plant

checkpoints.text: The 8,200-GPU (Nvidia B300) AI cluster in Australia goes live in early November 2026 and starts billing in Q3 FY27, as management said on the Q1 FY27 call (late September); go-live had slipped from October. Management gives no annual guidance
checkpoints.ifMet: The large GPU contract starts earning and the ₹1,177cr advance begins turning into revenue
checkpoints.ifMissed: A second delay; ESDS keeps carrying the commitment without the revenue

checkpoints.text: Profit after tax margin of at least 15% once the GPU contract bills, the bottom of the 15–20% management targets on large international GPU deals (Q1 FY27 was 22% before the contract)
checkpoints.ifMet: The pass-through deal is adding profit, not just revenue
checkpoints.ifMissed: The GPU deal is thinner than promised and dilutes the business

checkpoints.text: Its own GPU capacity raised to about 1,500 units (from 600–800) with IPO money by January–February 2027, billing from Q1 FY28, as stated on the Q1 FY27 call
checkpoints.ifMet: The IPO money is turning into domestic GPU capacity on time
checkpoints.ifMissed: Capacity lags; the domestic AI story slips a year

checkpoints.text: FY27 gross sales and profit after tax both up about 20%, reaffirmed on 29 Jul with profit growing faster than sales (FY26 PAT ₹98cr, so about ₹118cr). Gross sales are the full value billed (₹641cr in Q1, up 6%); filed revenue is lower because some software is booked net, so the check is on PAT and the company's gross-sales figure
checkpoints.ifMet: The slow Q1 was timing; the 10-year 20%-plus growth record holds
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth has slowed for a fourth quarter running, and the founders' return as managers has not fixed it

checkpoints.text: Information-lifecycle (storage and data) sales recovering from Q3 FY27 and cybersecurity growing faster than Q1's 8%, as management said on 29 Jul that budgets moved temporarily to AI and data-centre hardware
checkpoints.ifMet: Q1 was a budget shift, not lost business
checkpoints.ifMissed: The core security and storage lines are losing share

checkpoints.text: Data-centre infrastructure about 18–20% of FY27 sales and recurring (annuity) business about 45%, as the CFO said on 29 Jul (Q1: about 22% and 46.4%)
checkpoints.ifMet: The mix is shifting towards growth areas without losing the recurring base
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth depends on one-off hardware deals

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of ₹350–360cr, guided on 10 Aug, which is at least 28% growth on FY26's ₹273cr
checkpoints.ifMet: The new services and nearshore teams are scaling as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's 44% growth was front-loaded or one-off

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 24–25%, guided on 10 Aug (Q1 was 16.2%); the company's EBITDA excludes other income, the same basis as Screener's operating margin
checkpoints.ifMet: Q1's dip was the one-off hiring and training cost management described
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth is being bought with margin; the 27–40% margins of past years are not coming back

checkpoints.text: ₹12–15cr billed to UK exam board AQA in FY27 (₹2.5cr in Q1) on a deal management puts at about US$17m over four years, as stated on 10 Aug
checkpoints.ifMet: A second large customer is growing, easing the dependence on Pearson
checkpoints.ifMissed: The AQA roll-out is slower than promised

checkpoints.text: At least one of the acquisitions in talks (two non-binding offers made, one in the US and one in India, a third at an early stage) signed, as management said on 10 Aug the lead deal was in final negotiation
checkpoints.ifMet: IPO cash is being put to work; judge the price paid
checkpoints.ifMissed: The cash pile keeps growing without a use

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 'steady', as management put it on 28 July: revenue holding near last year's ₹121cr with a profit, while the delayed large orders start to be finalised
checkpoints.ifMet: The year stays on track for the second-half-heavy plan
checkpoints.ifMissed: Middle East delays are hurting more than management admits; the full-year guide is at risk

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of 20–25%, organic (about ₹493–514cr on FY26's ₹411cr), as guided on 28 July; this was trimmed from about 25% (25–30% in Q&A) in April
checkpoints.ifMet: Guidance kept after one trim; the order book is converting
checkpoints.ifMissed: A second miss on growth; the order book is not turning into revenue

checkpoints.text: FY27 net profit margin of 9–11% (company guidance on 28 July), meaning net profit of at least about ₹44cr on the low end of the revenue guide; this includes other income, which was ₹21cr in FY26
checkpoints.ifMet: The margin recovery from FY26's 9% operating margin is real
checkpoints.ifMissed: Margins stay squeezed by freight, input costs and war-time execution costs

checkpoints.text: Both proposed acquisitions, in Italy and Saudi Arabia, completed before March 2027, as management said on 28 July (due diligence under way), and the ~₹120cr Saudi contract delivered by Q3 with its receivables collected
checkpoints.ifMet: The IPO money is being put to work and cash starts coming in
checkpoints.ifMissed: Acquisitions keep slipping and receivables stay high; the IPO cash sits idle

checkpoints.text: Stage II forest clearance for the ESL Bokaro expansion received by the end of Q2 FY27, as the company said on the 30 July call (Stage I came in Q1). ESL's environmental clearance and consent to operate also hang on this; the plant has run under court orders since 2018
checkpoints.ifMet: The main hurdle to the 3.2 MTPA Bokaro plan, and to regularising the plant, is cleared
checkpoints.ifMissed: The Bokaro expansion and the plant's legal footing stay uncertain; the March 2027 date slips

checkpoints.text: The stock built up before the monsoon released in Q2 FY27, as management said: net debt at or below June's ₹2,733cr (company basis, including ₹960cr owed to Vedanta Ltd). The company gave no profit guidance; Q2 iron ore output already fell 13% and steel output rose 4%
checkpoints.ifMet: Cash is coming back as promised while capex runs
checkpoints.ifMissed: Working capital or capex is absorbing cash; the debt-to-EBITDA comfort of 1.3x weakens

checkpoints.text: ESL Bokaro hot-metal capacity expanded from 1.7 to 3.2 MTPA by the end of FY27 (₹2,975cr approved, ₹752cr left at June), and the 0.42 MTPA ductile-iron pipe plant in Goa finished in the later part of the year (₹722cr, ₹380cr left), as said on the 30 July call
checkpoints.ifMet: Steel volumes can roughly double from FY28, the base of the company's growth plan
checkpoints.ifMissed: The growth plan is late; steel profit stays small

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA near the US$284m (about ₹2,556cr at ₹90 a dollar) shown in the May 2026 listing presentation, against ₹1,127cr of operating profit in FY26 (Screener basis). Q1 gave ₹515cr (company basis), so about ₹680cr a quarter is needed for the rest of the year. Not repeated on the call
checkpoints.ifMet: The first step of the 4x-by-FY29 profit plan is real
checkpoints.ifMissed: The listing-day plan was too rosy; treat the FY29 target as aspiration

checkpoints.text: EBITDA margin of at least 12.5% in Q2 FY27, up from 12.2% in Q1, as the castings and steel price increases and firmer pig iron prices that management expects to show 'in quarter 2 and 3' come through. The company's EBITDA excludes other income, the same basis as Screener's operating margin. Management also warned that June–August is the peak for costly coal.
checkpoints.ifMet: Pricing is beating the coal and power cost squeeze; the 12% plateau may finally break
checkpoints.ifMissed: Margin stays stuck near 12% for a fourth year; cost pass-through is not working

checkpoints.text: The 35 MW solar plant and 12 windmills (about 25 MW) commissioned by September 2026, as the MD said on the call and the Q1 presentation shows. Management still expects ₹70–80cr a year of power savings from these, less than first planned after the new limits on green-power hours and power trading.
checkpoints.ifMet: Power cost, 9.3% of revenue in Q1 against 6.2% a year earlier, should start to fall
checkpoints.ifMissed: The power-cost squeeze in Maharashtra lasts longer

checkpoints.text: The new two-part foundry at Solapur for large castings (15,000 tonnes a year; 'by October' on the call, Q3 FY27 in the presentation) running, and the roughly 23,000 tonnes of ONGC and Oil India tube orders delivered 'in the next 2 quarters', that is by December 2026
checkpoints.ifMet: Higher-value castings start, and tube volumes and mix recover from Q1's 14% volume fall
checkpoints.ifMissed: Tubes stay a drag and the move into large castings slips

checkpoints.text: FY27 volumes as guided on 6 August: total volume up at least 15%; castings up 15% or more (the MD hinted 17–20%); external steel sales of 1–1.1 lakh tonnes (85,644 in FY26); tube volume up at least 10% (above about 2.08 lakh tonnes, from 1,88,704); pig iron production close to 7 lakh tonnes. Management gave no revenue or company-wide margin number.
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is back after four flat years of profit; would support a better view
checkpoints.ifMissed: Tubes and pig iron keep holding back the castings growth

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue of at least about ₹200cr: the CFO put July at a ₹65–75cr monthly run rate like Q1, though the MD warned of vessel shortages making Q2 'topsy turvy'
checkpoints.ifMet: Q1's jump was a new base, not a one-off
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1 was flattered; the doubling guide gets harder

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 90%, repeating FY26's 97% (FY26 was ₹386cr, so about ₹733cr or more); the MD said in July it could 'easily' reach the target an analyst put at ₹800cr
checkpoints.ifMet: The branch build-out is paying off as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: The headline promise slipped in its first year as a listed company

checkpoints.text: FY27 operating margin of at least 11%, 'almost same or maybe a little better' than FY26's 11.4% (it has almost no other income, so its basis and Screener's match)
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is not being bought with price cuts
checkpoints.ifMissed: New branches and outsourced air freight are diluting the margin

checkpoints.text: Borrowings no higher than about ₹200cr at March 2027 (₹108cr at March 2026), with customers paying within the 90 days management says it allows
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is funded within the limits management set
checkpoints.ifMissed: Receivables are outrunning sales and debt; cash strain rises

checkpoints.text: Air cargo volume growth in Q2 FY27 close to Q1's 23% (management said the Q1 volume trend was continuing into Q2; it gives no revenue guidance and says yields follow fuel prices)
checkpoints.ifMet: Market-share gains, not just fuel surcharges, are driving growth
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's 90% revenue jump was mostly freight-rate inflation

checkpoints.text: Quarterly finance cost clearly below Q1's ₹17.7cr in Q3 FY27, after about ₹140cr of debt was repaid from IPO money, as the CFO said
checkpoints.ifMet: The IPO is lifting net profit as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: Working-capital borrowing is creeping back as sales grow

checkpoints.text: The ASAP online booking platform launched (promised within 30–60 days of 18 September) and the cold-chain warehouse operational (promised for 'next quarter')
checkpoints.ifMet: Management delivers on its first post-listing promises
checkpoints.ifMissed: Launch dates slip in the first quarters as a listed company

checkpoints.text: Return on equity near the ~15% management targets for FY27 despite the larger post-IPO equity base
checkpoints.ifMet: The bigger equity base is being put to work
checkpoints.ifMissed: Returns diluted by the IPO money and new overseas offices

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue up at least 20% on a year earlier; the CEO said Leap will grow 20%-plus year on year every quarter (Q1 was about 19% on Screener's revenue)
checkpoints.ifMet: The roadshow promise holds in the festive quarter
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth is slowing toward the pooling-only 17–18% the CEO also cited

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 20%, the guidance repeated on the first call (FY26 revenue ₹730cr, so about ₹876cr or more), with the Gulf business counted in but small
checkpoints.ifMet: Guidance delivered in its first year as a listed company
checkpoints.ifMissed: The first full-year guide was missed

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin within the 47–56% band management gave, on its basis, which includes other income (50.7% in FY26); on Screener's basis, which excludes it, about 1–2 points lower, so at least 46%
checkpoints.ifMet: Pricing and CHEP integration savings are holding
checkpoints.ifMissed: Repair, transport or lower-margin forklift rental is eating into the margin

checkpoints.text: Customer payment days falling 10–15 days a quarter from 119 at June, with the CEO aiming to be 'up-to-date' within two to three quarters
checkpoints.ifMet: Cash conversion improves and borrowing needs fall
checkpoints.ifMissed: Receivables stay near four months of sales, as in FY24–FY26

checkpoints.text: EBITDA margin back to 23–25% in Q2 FY27 after Q1's 14%, as the MD said on 11 August once the 7% price rise and cooler VAM prices (about ₹100/kg from ₹170–180) work through. Company and Screener margins are close (company 14.4% vs Screener about 15% in Q1).
checkpoints.ifMet: Q1 was a one-off raw-material shock; pricing power is intact
checkpoints.ifMissed: Higher selling and staff costs are eating the margin, not just VAM

checkpoints.text: Revenue up at least 15% year on year in Q2 FY27 (₹85cr or more against ₹74cr), from the 15–20% volume growth management aims for plus the price rise it expects to stay in Q2
checkpoints.ifMet: The new-state push and dealer meets are producing volume
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth slips back toward the 6% a year of FY23–FY26

checkpoints.text: Santej brownfield expansion from 2,000 to 3,500 tonnes a month running in Q2 FY27 (about ₹7cr spent; said to support ₹600–650cr of revenue)
checkpoints.ifMet: Capacity is ready for the ₹500cr FY29 goal at almost no capital cost
checkpoints.ifMissed: A simple, cheap project slipping would be a warning on execution

checkpoints.text: Customer dues down to about 120–130 days of sales by March 2027, from about 150 days (₹145–150cr) at June 2026 and 185 days at March 2026; management promised it within two to three quarters
checkpoints.ifMet: Profit starts turning into cash; would support a move to own
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth is being bought with retailer credit; stays a follow at best

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of at least about ₹1,150cr, the first full quarter of STEAG and its four new contracts (three live from 1 July). Management said the acquisitions' impact shows 'from Q2 onwards'; the full-year guide of over ₹4,700cr (excluding foundit) needs about ₹1,250cr a quarter for the rest of the year after Q1's ₹930cr.
checkpoints.ifMet: STEAG is converting its ₹5,200cr order book on schedule
checkpoints.ifMissed: Contract ramp-up is slower than promised; the FY27 guide is at risk

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 40% on Screener's consolidated basis, in line with the guided ₹4,700cr-plus (up 42%) excluding foundit; management also guided EBITDA above ₹200cr and profit above ₹100cr, both excluding foundit
checkpoints.ifMet: The acquisition-led jump is real; the guided profit makes the price look reasonable
checkpoints.ifMissed: Guidance from the first full year after listing was too high

checkpoints.text: EBITDA margin above 5% in Q4 FY27, the exit rate management guided (3.8% in Q1 on its basis excluding foundit; Screener's consolidated figure, which includes foundit's losses, was 2.2%). With foundit due to break even by Q4, the two bases should be close.
checkpoints.ifMet: The mix shift to industrial O&M and airline catering is lifting margins toward the 5.5–6% long-term goal
checkpoints.ifMissed: It remains a 2–4% margin labour business

checkpoints.text: foundit (the job site) at EBITDA breakeven in Q4 FY27, with quarterly sales of ₹38–40cr and costs held at ₹31–33cr; the full-year cash burn guided at ₹35–40cr (₹14cr loss in Q1)
checkpoints.ifMet: The consolidated loss disappears and a sale of foundit to repay debt becomes possible
checkpoints.ifMissed: foundit keeps dragging the group into a reported loss

checkpoints.text: Operating margin of at least 23% in Q2 FY27 on Screener's basis (Q1 was 23%; the company's 25.1% includes other income). The MD said on 24 July he sees no dramatic change from Q1 and a positive bias from mix and operating leverage, despite costlier imported chips.
checkpoints.ifMet: Price rises and mix are covering the rupee and freight hit
checkpoints.ifMissed: Input costs are squeezing margins more than management signalled

checkpoints.text: The new Bengaluru metal-card plant (50,000 sq ft) operational by December 2026, after regulatory approvals, as said on the Q1 call
checkpoints.ifMet: Capacity is in place for premium and export card growth in FY28
checkpoints.ifMissed: The payments recovery story slips another year

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 8%, the bottom of the 8–12% guided on 24 July (FY26 revenue ₹1,441cr, so at least about ₹1,556cr)
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is back after a flat FY26; non-card businesses are carrying it
checkpoints.ifMissed: Card volumes are still shrinking faster than IoT can make up

checkpoints.text: IoT revenue up about 45% in FY27 (₹154cr in FY26, so about ₹220cr or more), the growth management expects to repeat
checkpoints.ifMet: RFID and SIM work is becoming a real second leg
checkpoints.ifMissed: The diversification away from cards is slower than claimed

checkpoints.text: Operating margin of at least 29% in Q2 FY27; on 5 October the CFO said Q2 could be 'in the similar range' to Q1's 29.6% (company and Screener both exclude other income), with the rupee and raw-material costs similar
checkpoints.ifMet: Operating leverage is covering the rupee and input-cost hit
checkpoints.ifMissed: Input costs are eating into the margin faster than guided

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 30%, the bottom of the 30–35% guided on the first call (FY26 revenue ₹1,327cr, so at least about ₹1,725cr)
checkpoints.ifMet: Exports, metal cards and tax stamps are a real growth engine
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's 48% jump was lumpy contracts, not a new growth rate

checkpoints.text: FY27 operating margin of about 30%, as guided ('roughly around 30%'; 32% in FY26 on Screener's basis)
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is coming without giving up margin
checkpoints.ifMissed: Faster growth is costing margin; the price needs re-checking

checkpoints.text: ₹100–120cr of the ₹238cr IPO capex spent in FY27, including a personalisation bureau in a developed market (about ₹30cr) and the start of tripling metal-card capacity
checkpoints.ifMet: Capacity for exports and metal cards arrives on plan
checkpoints.ifMissed: IPO money idles; growth beyond FY27 depends on capacity

checkpoints.text: The new North operation (Nagaur, Rajasthan) at EBITDA breakeven in September 2026, after a ₹40cr operating loss in Q1 FY27; the CEO said September is when it breaks even
checkpoints.ifMet: The North entry is working and stops dragging profits
checkpoints.ifMissed: The North costs more than planned; margins stay below the old 18–19%

checkpoints.text: The extra 1 MTPA grinding unit at Nagaur commissioned by end-September/early October, with the waste-heat power, overland conveyor and alternative-fuel systems running
checkpoints.ifMet: Clinker costs should fall from Q3 as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: Cost savings are delayed into FY28

checkpoints.text: High-teens total sales volume growth in FY27 (cement plus GGBS, including the North; Q1 was 15%), with GGBS up in high single digits, as guided on 14 August
checkpoints.ifMet: The capacity added is finding buyers
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth is slower than the capex plan assumes

checkpoints.text: Net debt kept below 3 times EBITDA (the board's limit; 2.95 times at June) while spending about ₹2,300cr of capex in FY27
checkpoints.ifMet: The expansion is being funded without stretching the balance sheet
checkpoints.ifMissed: Debt is outrunning profits; equity or slower expansion may follow

checkpoints.text: H1 FY27 revenue of about ₹200cr (about ₹100cr a quarter), against roughly ₹111cr in H1 FY26, as the chairman projected on 21 May 2026
checkpoints.ifMet: Execution is being spread through the year instead of piling into March
checkpoints.ifMissed: Billing is again back-ended; receivables and borrowing will rise again

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 45%, the bottom of the 45–50% management aims to keep (about ₹550cr on FY26's ₹380cr; the half-year guide implies ₹520–540cr)
checkpoints.ifMet: The order book is converting at the promised pace
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth targets were set too high for its execution capacity

checkpoints.text: FY27 operating margin held at about FY26's level (10% on Screener's basis; the company's adjusted EBITDA was about 10.4%), as guided
checkpoints.ifMet: Price-variation clauses are protecting it from copper and steel costs
checkpoints.ifMissed: Fixed-price execution and NOVA spending are eroding a thin margin

checkpoints.text: About ₹1,000cr of new orders in FY27 (₹350cr in the first 45 days) and operating cash flow close to neutral for the year, as management said it is aiming for
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth stops consuming cash; would justify another look
checkpoints.ifMissed: Another year of borrowing to fund customer dues

checkpoints.text: Unit 2 (about ₹60cr, 25 imported machines in the first lot) starts partial production from August 2026, as promised on the June call
checkpoints.ifMet: The FY27 plan of ₹18cr from Unit 2 is alive
checkpoints.ifMissed: Another delay; FY27's ₹48cr target is at risk

checkpoints.text: All Unit 2 machines delivered and installed by about December 2026, so the plant can be fully running in FY28
checkpoints.ifMet: The FY28 run-rate of ₹90–100cr becomes plausible
checkpoints.ifMissed: Machine lead times (6–10 months from Europe and Japan) push the ramp-up into FY28

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of about ₹48cr (₹30cr from the full first plant, ₹18cr from Unit 2), growth of about 57% on FY26's ₹30.65cr
checkpoints.ifMet: The first public-company guidance is delivered
checkpoints.ifMissed: Unit 2 is late or orders do not convert; the 93x P/E has no cushion

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin between 37% and 40%, the band the MD said he could 'confidently' hold (company basis matches Screener's: 37.5% in FY26)
checkpoints.ifMet: Unit 2 fixed costs are being absorbed
checkpoints.ifMissed: Margin keeps sliding from FY25's 49.8%; the premium price loses its main support

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue up at least 15% on Q2 FY26 (₹537cr or more against ₹467cr, consolidated); management said in August that the season was on track and Q2 usually brings about 60% of the year's profit
checkpoints.ifMet: The weak Q1 (revenue up 2%) was only timing
checkpoints.ifMissed: The Kharif season or exports fell short; the 15% yearly growth claim weakens

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of about 15%, the rate management says the business runs at (₹1,745cr or more, consolidated)
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth guidance kept in its first listed year
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth stalls at the level of an ordinary generic maker

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 12–13%, as guided in August (company basis matches Screener's: Q1 was 'around 11%' on both; it excludes the ₹5.7cr land gain in other income)
checkpoints.ifMet: Patented products are lifting margins as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: Higher costs and China competition are eating the mix gain

checkpoints.text: ALCU's new capacity fully installed by about Diwali or December 2026, taking total capacity from about 19,700 to 35,000–36,000 tonnes a year, and copper-transposed-conductor (CTC) output starting after October
checkpoints.ifMet: The doubling of capacity is on schedule for a full FY28
checkpoints.ifMissed: Capacity slips; the FY27 volume step-up is smaller than promised

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin above FY26's 4.7%, as new value-added products lift profit per tonne (company and Screener bases match: 4.66% and 4.7% in FY26)
checkpoints.ifMet: The move up the value chain is showing in the margin
checkpoints.ifMissed: It is still a thin-margin copper converter; Q1 FY27 was already down to 4.0%

checkpoints.text: Working-capital cycle down from about 60 days to 50–52 days, with customers paying in about 35 days instead of 41, as the CFO and MD promised in May (no figure given for FY27 growth)
checkpoints.ifMet: Profit may finally start arriving as cash
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth keeps eating cash, as in every year since FY22

checkpoints.text: The YEIDA plant (about ₹184cr, four times today's capacity) starts commercial production from August 2026, after a two-month delay blamed on a local steel-fabrication supplier
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth can resume; the old plant is at about 124% of its rated capacity
checkpoints.ifMissed: A second delay; FY27's ₹200cr target depends on this plant

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of ₹200cr, as guided in June (31% above FY26's ₹152cr); then ₹250cr in FY28 and ₹300cr in FY29
checkpoints.ifMet: The new plant is filling as planned
checkpoints.ifMissed: The plant is late or slow to win business

checkpoints.text: Operating margin held near FY26's level despite the new plant's depreciation; management's 'about 25%' includes other income, Screener's basis was about 24% in FY26
checkpoints.ifMet: Quality of earnings holds while it quadruples capacity
checkpoints.ifMissed: The new plant's costs arrive before its sales

checkpoints.text: Safranal starts bringing revenue by the end of Q2 FY27, and phenol-derivative trial production starts by the end of Q2 (management gave no revenue or margin guidance for FY27)
checkpoints.ifMet: The ₹270cr Dahej plant has begun to earn
checkpoints.ifMissed: The new plant keeps adding depreciation and interest without sales

checkpoints.text: Meaningful revenue from cooling agents (Gemcool 3, 5 and 23, approved by the two largest buyers) and from Safranal, and phenol derivatives in commercial production
checkpoints.ifMet: Krystal is on the path to more than half of revenue in FY28
checkpoints.ifMissed: Customer approvals are slower than promised; the consolidated loss continues

checkpoints.text: Phenol derivatives bring meaningful revenue, the clove (eugenol) business ends the year close to plan after Madagascar's floods, and the promised FY28 guidance is given around the end of 2026
checkpoints.ifMet: A return to consolidated profit becomes visible
checkpoints.ifMissed: FY27 is lost and FY28 rests on hope

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of ₹1,550–1,650cr, as guided in September (26–34% above FY26's ₹1,233cr, standalone)
checkpoints.ifMet: First-year guidance kept; the ₹2,800–3,000cr five-year aim gains weight
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's price-driven jump was the peak

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA of ₹240–250cr excluding Q1's ₹25cr inventory gain and forex (margin 15–16%); on Screener's basis, which includes that gain, about ₹265–275cr
checkpoints.ifMet: Margins are settling at a structurally higher level than FY26's 11%
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's margin was mostly a windfall

checkpoints.text: New antibacterial-ingredient plant mechanically complete by about January 2027, lubricant-additive capacity up 50%-plus by debottlenecking before March, and Mahad utilisation above 70% by year-end
checkpoints.ifMet: The ₹250–300cr Phase 1 expansion is on track for FY28 growth
checkpoints.ifMissed: Projects slip and the growth plan stretches

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of more than ₹700cr (about 39% growth on FY26's ₹503cr), as the CFO said on 10 August he was '100%' sure of
checkpoints.ifMet: The raised guide (from ₹650cr) is delivered and the ₹1,000cr FY29 goal stays credible
checkpoints.ifMissed: Registration delays are biting; the FY29–FY30 targets look stretched

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 26–27% as guided (Screener's operating margin was 24% in FY26 and 25% in Q1 FY27, on the same basis as the company's FY26 figure)
checkpoints.ifMet: Operating leverage is real, on the path to the 29–30% promised at ₹1,000cr of revenue
checkpoints.ifMissed: The mix shift to lower-margin ROW markets is holding margins back

checkpoints.text: Debtor days down to 165–170 by March 2027 from 203–208 in FY26, with receivables of about ₹300cr on ₹700cr of sales, as the CFO guided
checkpoints.ifMet: Profit starts turning into cash; would improve the view
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth keeps being financed by customers' unpaid bills; cash conversion stays poor

checkpoints.text: KPMG appointed as statutory auditor (through an EGM) by Q3 or Q4 FY27, as promised for the second call running
checkpoints.ifMet: A big governance worry eases; the related-party questions get a stronger referee
checkpoints.ifMissed: A second missed promise on the auditor would argue for staying away

checkpoints.text: Hormone plant (Unit 6) gets its manufacturing licence and starts by November 2026, for ₹70–80cr of tender sales in FY28
checkpoints.ifMet: The next growth leg is on time
checkpoints.ifMissed: New units are slipping; FY28 growth leans more on registrations

checkpoints.text: FY27 consolidated revenue growth of about 20% (management allowed plus or minus 5 points), guided on 22 September; FY26 was ₹869cr
checkpoints.ifMet: The first-year guide as a listed company is delivered, with the new businesses starting to count
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth is still only the high-single-digit API business; the new plants are late

checkpoints.text: FY27 consolidated EBITDA up about 25% (roughly ₹300cr against FY26's ₹239cr on Screener's basis), helped by H2 milestone payments that management says will fully offset the ₹23cr a quarter of new-business running costs
checkpoints.ifMet: The capex drag is being paid for, as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: ₹1,000cr of new plants are weighing on profit without income; the P/E looks stretched

checkpoints.text: Definitive licensing agreement with a large US drug company for its dual-chamber vial products signed in early Q3 FY27, and the second US filing (ANDA) made by Q4
checkpoints.ifMet: The injectables bet has a committed partner
checkpoints.ifMissed: The term sheet has not converted; the Mhow plant's payback moves out

checkpoints.text: First commercial revenue from the Ujjain fermentation (biotech CDMO) plant in Q4 FY27, with the European alternative-protein contract signed
checkpoints.ifMet: The take-or-pay contracts start paying
checkpoints.ifMissed: The CDMO story stays a slide; the plant runs at a cost

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin better than Q1's 17.9%, as the MD said on 6 August after raising selling prices (company and Screener margins match here)
checkpoints.ifMet: Price rises are sticking with its 10–15 big customers
checkpoints.ifMissed: It cannot pass on solvent costs; the 25% promise is in doubt

checkpoints.text: EBITDA margin back to at least 25% by Q3 FY27, the level management said it would 'normalise' to (it had promised not to go below 24–25% in Q1, then reported 17.9%)
checkpoints.ifMet: Q1 was a one-off cost shock, as claimed
checkpoints.ifMissed: A second missed margin promise; the guidance cannot be relied on

checkpoints.text: FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹350–400cr (about double FY26's ₹172cr, mostly from consolidating Apiqo and Bizotic), with nothing yet counted from Remember India
checkpoints.ifMet: The acquired plants deliver the promised scale
checkpoints.ifMissed: The acquisition-led growth story is falling short

checkpoints.text: Positive operating cash flow for FY27, which the MD said he would achieve 'with the best of our efforts' after tightening payment terms; it has been negative in every year shown since FY21
checkpoints.ifMet: First sign profit is real cash; would soften the view
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth keeps eating cash while ₹70cr of new debt funds the expansion

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 50% (to about ₹153cr from ₹102cr), the 'minimum' the MD guided on 5 May; Q1 FY27 grew only 31%
checkpoints.ifMet: The bed and clinic roll-out is real and filling
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth guidance was promotional; Q1 already ran well behind it

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin above FY26's 30.6% (company basis, which appears to include other income; Screener's operating margin was about 30%), as the MD said margins 'will be higher than this'
checkpoints.ifMet: New hospitals break even quickly, as claimed
checkpoints.ifMissed: Expansion costs (new staff, clinics, luxury centre) are eating the margin

checkpoints.text: Beds raised from about 223 to 350–500 and 30 new super-specialty clinics opened during FY27, as planned on the call
checkpoints.ifMet: Capacity for the 50% growth target is in place
checkpoints.ifMissed: The 1,500–2,000-bed, three-year ambition looks unrealistic

checkpoints.text: The 25-bed luxury wellness centre in Delhi operating, which the MD said in May would open 'within the next three months'; and the General Insurance Corporation cashless tie-up finalised
checkpoints.ifMet: A higher-ticket patient segment and insurance funnel open up
checkpoints.ifMissed: Execution is slipping against near-term promises

checkpoints.text: SteriPort Line 3 (5.4 crore more bottles a year) in commercial production from late August 2026 after the state FDA inspection, four to five months later than first planned; management said Q2 would gain only September's output
checkpoints.ifMet: The main FY27 growth engine is running
checkpoints.ifMissed: A second delay; the FY27 revenue guide is at risk

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of about ₹370cr (about 28% growth on ₹288cr), with roughly ₹70cr coming from the new SteriPort line in its first seven months
checkpoints.ifMet: Capacity, not demand, was the limit, as management argued
checkpoints.ifMissed: The new bottles are not selling as fast as promised

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 25–26% (plus or minus a point), from operating leverage and ₹9cr a year of solar savings; the company's figure includes other income (FY26: about 22% on its basis, 21% on Screener's)
checkpoints.ifMet: The 4–5 point margin step-up is real; returns on capital start to rise
checkpoints.ifMissed: Overheads and polymer costs are absorbing the new volume

checkpoints.text: New small-volume (SVP) line for inhalation, eye-drop and diluent exports commercial by February–March 2027, after factory acceptance in the US in November
checkpoints.ifMet: The export growth leg for FY28 is in place
checkpoints.ifMissed: FY28's ₹425cr target slips

checkpoints.text: The new 75,000 sq ft nutraceutical plant (2.5 times today's capacity) and the Olahey ready-to-drink beverage plant ready and applying for licences by July–August 2026, as the MD said on 22 May
checkpoints.ifMet: The capacity behind the ₹450–500cr FY29 target is in place
checkpoints.ifMissed: The growth plan slips a year

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 25% (the 'minimum' of the 25–30% guide; ₹183cr or more on FY26's ₹147cr), with ₹40–50cr hoped for from the new plant in H2
checkpoints.ifMet: Client demand is filling the new capacity
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth depends on a few big clients and is slowing

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 20–22%, as guided (FY26: 20.3%, the same basis as Screener's, excluding other income), with net margin near 14%
checkpoints.ifMet: New-plant staff costs are absorbed and cost-plus pricing works
checkpoints.ifMissed: Big clients and pre-hired staff are squeezing the margin

checkpoints.text: Cordelia Sky sails from 23 October and lifts Q3 FY27 (the festive and wedding quarter) clearly above Q2, with the operating margin back to the mid-20s or better without one-offs. Management gave no numbers (it says it may not give forward guidance), only that bookings leave it in a 'very happy place' and the strong quarters are still to come.
checkpoints.ifMet: The second ship is filling at good prices; the capacity story starts to show in profit
checkpoints.ifMissed: Doubling capacity is outrunning demand or the new lease costs bite; the price looks even harder to justify

checkpoints.text: The fuel penalty neutralised by Q4 FY27, as the CEO hoped: fuel cost per available passenger day well below Q2's ₹2,471 (₹1,434 a year earlier), with the $15–20 a day surcharge covering the rest. About ₹28cr of extra fuel cost hit H1.
checkpoints.ifMet: Margins can head toward the 35–40% global level management talks about
checkpoints.ifMissed: Fuel stays a drag of roughly ₹12–15cr a quarter on one ship, more with two

checkpoints.text: Third ship, Sun, delivered about September–October 2027 ('in 11 months', said on 9 October), and the ₹429cr advanced for a fourth ship either turned into a named vessel deal or returned.
checkpoints.ifMet: Fleet plan on schedule and the large advance accounted for
checkpoints.ifMissed: A delayed ship or an unexplained advance would be a serious warning

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 holds up despite traffic that management said in August was running at about Q1's flat level, with international routes still cut. No number was guided; the test is whether revenue keeps growing on new outlets (Q1: +20.6%) while like-for-like sales stay positive.
checkpoints.ifMet: New outlets are carrying growth through a weak traffic patch
checkpoints.ifMissed: The traffic slump is biting harder than the network growth can offset

checkpoints.text: The H2 traffic bounce management expects as airlines restore long-haul routes from September–October, with like-for-like sales growing 5–7 points faster than passenger traffic, its usual gap. Note that Delhi T3 leaves the consolidated accounts after 30 September (it moves to a 30%-owned GMR joint venture), so reported revenue will dip for reasons unrelated to demand.
checkpoints.ifMet: The spending engine is intact and the Delhi change is only an accounting shift
checkpoints.ifMissed: Traffic or spending per traveller is weaker than management assumes

checkpoints.text: EBITDA margin back to its usual level of about 38% or more as start-up costs at Noida, Cochin and Delhi fade 'within another 12 months or so' (Q1 FY27: 35.8%; company EBITDA and Screener's operating margin are on the same basis here, both excluding other income)
checkpoints.ifMet: The 90 new units are maturing as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: New airports are slower to pay back than the 12–24 months management describes

checkpoints.text: Chennai and Kolkata concessions, which come up for renewal at the end of March 2027 and early FY28, retained.
checkpoints.ifMet: The renewal record (about 92% of contracts) holds
checkpoints.ifMissed: Losing two large airports would cut revenue and test the moat

checkpoints.text: Operating (EBITDA) margin of about 20% in Q2 FY27, the level the CFO called 'the new normal' and an internal target, even with more lower-priced domestic orders in the mix (Q1: 19.9%; company EBITDA matches Screener's operating profit here, both excluding other income)
checkpoints.ifMet: Pricing and discount discipline is holding at the top of the cycle
checkpoints.ifMissed: Steel and parts costs or the domestic mix are eating into margins; FY24's 8% is the reminder of how far they can fall

checkpoints.text: Order book at or above June's ₹1,778cr; management said it does not see the order cycle peaking soon.
checkpoints.ifMet: Customers are still expanding; FY28 visibility holds
checkpoints.ifMissed: Orders are being executed faster than they are replaced; the capex cycle may be turning

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of 20–25%, as guided by the CFO on 20 August (₹2,060–2,146cr on FY26's ₹1,717cr); the CMD agreed with an analyst's ₹2,150–2,200cr estimate
checkpoints.ifMet: The order book is converting on time
checkpoints.ifMissed: Execution or orders are slipping

checkpoints.text: FY27 operating (EBITDA) margin of at least 20%, the internal target (FY26: 19%, same basis as Screener)
checkpoints.ifMet: The margin recovery from FY24's 8% is real and holding
checkpoints.ifMissed: Margins are slipping back from the cycle high

checkpoints.text: First results as a listed company hold the operating margin at or near CY2025's 18% (Screener basis, excluding other income) with sales still growing (CY2025: +9%). No results call has been held and no forward guidance was found in the documents read, so this is a qualitative check.
checkpoints.ifMet: The margin recovery from 14% in 2023 is holding after listing
checkpoints.ifMissed: Wind or construction-equipment demand, or group pricing, is squeezing margins

checkpoints.text: Royalty to the parent stays near 4.4% of revenue and related-party terms (sales to group firms about 15% of revenue, loans to a fellow subsidiary) are disclosed clearly in the first annual report as a listed company.
checkpoints.ifMet: Minority shareholders are treated on arm's-length terms
checkpoints.ifMissed: A rising royalty or new group loans would be a governance warning

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin 'very similar' to FY25–FY26 (24% and 27% on Screener's basis, which matches the company's here: Q1 was 30.7% company, 30% Screener). Management gives no formal guidance; this is the only number it offered.
checkpoints.ifMet: The richer defence-solutions mix is holding
checkpoints.ifMissed: Margins swing with lumpy parachute contracts more than management implies

checkpoints.text: Positive operating cash for FY27, as the management said on 14 August ('it will be positive'), with debtor days back from 123 at March 2026 toward the earlier 26–33.
checkpoints.ifMet: Profit starts reaching cash; would move it up from wait
checkpoints.ifMissed: Cash stays tied up in stock and receivables, as in FY25–FY26

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue above FY26's ₹692cr: management called it 'a steady, good year of growth' without a number, with capacity only 55–60% used after last year's expansion.
checkpoints.ifMet: New approvals and outdoor-brand orders are filling the new capacity
checkpoints.ifMissed: Tender timing or approvals are slipping

checkpoints.text: EBITDA margin back to 24–25% in Q2 FY27, as the steel-cost price increases granted by OEMs from 1 April are billed (Q1: 19.6%). The company's margin has run close to Screener's operating margin (about 22% in FY25–FY26), so the same basis.
checkpoints.ifMet: Cost pass-through to OEMs works as the CMD says
checkpoints.ifMissed: Its pricing power with large OEMs is weaker than claimed

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 20% ('minimum', said on 22 September), i.e. about ₹227cr or more on FY26's ₹189cr; Q1 grew only 13%
checkpoints.ifMet: New OEMs (Tata Hitachi, Sany) and US plants of John Deere are adding business
checkpoints.ifMissed: Guidance was too eager for a first year as a listed company

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of at least 24% (FY26: 22% on Screener), with net profit up 25–30% (FY26: ₹23cr, so about ₹29–30cr)
checkpoints.ifMet: Exports and automation are lifting margins as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: Margins stay at the old 22%; growth in profit will be slower than guided

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue up at least 35% on Q2 FY26 (₹96.6cr), in line with the 35–40% FY27 growth the CMD gave on 24 September
checkpoints.ifMet: The acquisition-led growth plan is on track
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth is slowing even with the acquired units added

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 35% (about ₹452cr or more on FY26's ₹335cr), as guided on 24 September; most of it comes from the acquired Uro Veneer, Chawla Brothers and Fabwood
checkpoints.ifMet: Guidance delivered, though largely bought rather than organic
checkpoints.ifMissed: Even bought growth fell short

checkpoints.text: Consolidated PAT margin of 20–22% for FY27, as guided on 24 September (it was 22.5% in FY26 and 18.9% in Q1 FY27); the margin is on profit after tax, not Screener's operating margin
checkpoints.ifMet: The lower-margin acquired units are not diluting profit too much
checkpoints.ifMissed: Acquisitions are buying sales at the cost of margin

checkpoints.text: Fabwood deal (56% for up to ₹42.7cr) closed around 8 October and paid from internal cash within 120 days, with no borrowing, as promised on 24 September
checkpoints.ifMet: Acquisitions remain self-funded
checkpoints.ifMissed: Deal-making is starting to need debt

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹55–60cr, as guided on 27 July (Q1 was ₹47cr), with the new Purulia (Metalurgica) plant through its September trial runs
checkpoints.ifMet: The ramp to the ₹250cr year is on track
checkpoints.ifMissed: The new plant or demand is slower than promised
checkpoints.actual: ₹54cr

checkpoints.text: Operating margin of at least 22% in Q2 FY27, the bottom of the 22–25% range management keeps guiding (Q1 was 28%). The company's EBITDA and Screener's operating margin matched in Q1; inward freight sits in other expenses
checkpoints.ifMet: The premium SGB Limited grade is holding the margin as volumes double
checkpoints.ifMissed: New capacity is being filled at lower prices

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of about ₹250cr, guided on 27 July (about 85% growth on FY26's ₹135cr; the May presentation said ₹250–300cr)
checkpoints.ifMet: The doubled capacity is selling; FY28's ₹500–550cr target becomes credible
checkpoints.ifMissed: The capacity build-out is running ahead of demand

checkpoints.text: Nawada quartzite mine producing by January–February 2027, cutting stone cost by about ₹1,300–1,400 a tonne and raw-material stock to ₹4–5cr from ₹20–30cr, as promised on 30 September
checkpoints.ifMet: The cost edge and the cash release are real; supports the 4–5 point margin lift talked of for FY28
checkpoints.ifMissed: The cost-saving story slips and inventory keeps tying up cash

checkpoints.text: H1 FY27 revenue up at least 20% on H1 FY26 (₹80cr), the low end of the 20–30% yearly growth the MD gave on 21 May, helped by the delayed US order shipped in April–May
checkpoints.ifMet: The ₹272cr order book is converting on time
checkpoints.ifMissed: Execution or the new plants are lagging

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 20% (₹238cr or more on FY26's ₹198cr), the bottom of the 20–30% guided on 21 May
checkpoints.ifMet: Guidance delivered in the first year after the IPO
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth slowed for a second year (FY26 was +13%)

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of at least 11.5%, i.e. the 'at least 100 basis points a year' improvement promised on 21 May on FY26's 10.5% (company basis excludes other income, same as Screener)
checkpoints.ifMet: Exports and new products are lifting a thin margin
checkpoints.ifMissed: The EPC-heavy order book (53%) is diluting margin

checkpoints.text: GIS plant at Karachiya, Vadodara, open by September 2026, and the rented Odisha unit running fully by October 2026, as promised on 21 May
checkpoints.ifMet: IPO capex is on time; the ₹300cr extra revenue potential becomes testable
checkpoints.ifMissed: Capex delays push out the growth case

checkpoints.text: Kutch (Gujarat) tower plant through customer approvals and producing, lifting utilisation from FY26's 48% of 612 towers a year (management, October 2026 investor-conference note). No numeric guidance was given
checkpoints.ifMet: The capacity bought with FY26's ₹97cr of investment starts earning
checkpoints.ifMissed: A half-empty plant built with borrowed money weighs on returns

checkpoints.text: The largest-ever order (38 towers, ₹134cr before GST, for an Andhra Pradesh wind project) delivered by Q4 FY27 as promised on 10 September, on top of the ₹360cr order book at March 2026
checkpoints.ifMet: It can execute integrated-supply orders at scale
checkpoints.ifMissed: Execution and working capital are stretched by the bigger, steel-buying orders

checkpoints.text: EBITDA per tower above FY26's ₹29 lakh, the measure management asks to be judged on. It warned the margin (43% in FY26, about 50% if pure conversion) will fall as integrated-supply orders (14–16% margin) grow. There is no margin target, so this is qualitative
checkpoints.ifMet: Moving to fuller-scope orders adds profit, not just revenue
checkpoints.ifMissed: Bigger orders are diluting both margin and profit per tower

checkpoints.text: By end-Q2 FY27, as promised on 13 August: the 1.2 GWh Jhajjar battery-storage (BESS) plant and the Gujarat UPS plant running, and receivables, ₹231cr in June and mostly a single government police-IT (CCTNS) project, roughly halved
checkpoints.ifMet: The cash problem is easing and the delayed plant is finally live
checkpoints.ifMissed: Another quarter of stuck government money and plant delays

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of at least 25% (₹482cr or more on FY26's ₹386cr), the 'minimum' guided on 13 August
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth guidance delivered despite the slow BESS ramp
checkpoints.ifMissed: Growth slowed for a second year (FY26 was +10%)

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 12–13%, as reaffirmed on 13 August (Q1 was 8.5%; the company's figure matches Screener's operating margin), with PAT margin of 8.5–9%
checkpoints.ifMet: A strong second half rescued the year, as management expects
checkpoints.ifMissed: New plant costs and BESS pricing are squeezing margins

checkpoints.text: Positive operating cash flow for FY27 and working capital of 120–150 days by March 2027 (185 days at March 2026), as targeted on 13 August
checkpoints.ifMet: First positive operating cash year in five; would improve the view
checkpoints.ifMissed: A sixth year in a row of profit without cash

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue up at least 10% year on year (Q2 FY26: ₹650cr), keeping up the double-digit growth the CEO called the company's ambition on 4 August. This is a stated ambition, not formal guidance; the company gives none
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth is back after eight single-digit quarters, helped by price rises
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's 11.5% was a one-quarter pricing bump

checkpoints.text: Kerala distribution overhaul on the timeline given on 4 August (open-format outlets by December 2026, spices by March 2027), with Eastern's Kerala market share no longer falling (it lost about 0.3 points). No numeric target
checkpoints.ifMet: Eastern, the 2021 acquisition, starts adding to growth
checkpoints.ifMissed: Kerala keeps dragging volumes, which grew only 1.7% overall in Q1

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue of at least about ₹725cr, so that the first half reaches the 40–45% of the ₹3,200–3,400cr FY27 target that the CFO promised on 6 August (Q1 was ₹555cr)
checkpoints.ifMet: Revenue is less bunched into March than last year, as promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: The year again depends on a giant fourth quarter, which last year came with ballooning receivables

checkpoints.text: Battery-storage (BESS) assembly capacity at 10 GWh, with the new 5 GWh line installed in October–November and running by early December 2026
checkpoints.ifMet: It keeps its claimed lead in Indian battery-container output
checkpoints.ifMissed: Capacity slips just as rivals add plants

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue of ₹3,200–3,400cr, at least 21% more than FY26's ₹2,641cr, as reaffirmed on 6 August, with a profit-after-tax margin of 10.5–11%
checkpoints.ifMet: The order book is turning into revenue on schedule
checkpoints.ifMissed: Execution or billing is slipping despite the ₹10,800cr order book

checkpoints.text: Operating cash flow positive for FY27, as the CFO said to expect by March, after −₹842cr in FY26 and −₹176cr in FY25
checkpoints.ifMet: Profit finally starts to arrive as cash; would improve the view
checkpoints.ifMissed: Profits remain on paper, tied up in receivables and in its own battery projects

checkpoints.text: New orders arriving: no order of substance came in during the three months to early October, though the MD said a couple of jobs, including in new markets such as Canada and Israel, were very close; the order book should stay near the ₹982cr of July 2026
checkpoints.ifMet: The two years of visibility management aims for is being kept up
checkpoints.ifMissed: Order wins are lagging execution, which would threaten 25% growth in FY28

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of about 25% (about ₹570cr against ₹457cr), as guided on 7 October, with export deliveries concentrated in Q3 and Q4
checkpoints.ifMet: The first-year guidance as a listed company is delivered
checkpoints.ifMissed: The export pickup promised for the second half did not arrive

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 23–25% (company basis excludes other income, the same as Screener's), with net profit at 18–20% of sales, despite pass-through freight now inflating revenue
checkpoints.ifMet: The high margins of the last two years are sustainable
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q1's 21% was not just freight and mix; margins are drifting back towards the old 10–15%

checkpoints.text: In-house glass processing unit (₹80cr, ₹60cr from the IPO) starting to commission in about eight months from October 2026, adding about 1–1.5% to margins
checkpoints.ifMet: Backward integration lifts margins and control of supply
checkpoints.ifMissed: The IPO-funded project slips

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 operating margin clearly above Q1's 11%: on the 7 October call, after the quarter had ended, the Joint MD said Q2 margins were 'far better' despite high freight costs. The company's EBITDA and Screener's operating profit match (both exclude other income).
checkpoints.ifMet: Freight costs are being absorbed and the new plants are starting to cover their fixed costs
checkpoints.ifMissed: A miss straight after listing; the 'far better' remark was loose talk

checkpoints.text: Borrowings down after the IPO: ₹600cr of the ₹675cr fresh issue was earmarked to repay loans and acceptances, so the September balance sheet should show debt well below March's ₹1,030cr
checkpoints.ifMet: Interest costs fall and the IPO money went where it was promised
checkpoints.ifMissed: Debt stays high as capex keeps running ahead of cash

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of 60–65% (about ₹6,900–7,100cr against ₹4,312cr), as guided on 7 October; management says 58–60% of a year's revenue comes in the second half
checkpoints.ifMet: The first-year guidance as a listed company is delivered
checkpoints.ifMissed: The growth promised at listing was too high

checkpoints.text: Saudi Arabia plant (transmission towers and solar parts) running trials from December 2026, with its galvanising line online by February or at the latest March 2027
checkpoints.ifMet: Local-content Saudi work, which management says earns better margins, can start adding revenue in FY28
checkpoints.ifMissed: The next leg of growth slips a year

checkpoints.text: Q2 FY27 revenue of at least about ₹114cr, so that the first half reaches the 35% of a 50%-growth year that the CFO described on 20 May (Q1 was ₹122cr)
checkpoints.ifMet: The year is on course for the guided growth
checkpoints.ifMissed: Execution is slowing as the order book runs down

checkpoints.text: New orders from the ₹900cr-plus tender pipeline (management expects to win 30–40%), lifting the order book above the ₹621cr of March 2026 and adding work outside Gujarat or at 765 kV
checkpoints.ifMet: Growth beyond FY27 is funded by orders, and dependence on GETCO falls
checkpoints.ifMissed: The order book, already below December's ₹745cr, keeps shrinking

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of about 50% (about ₹674cr against ₹449cr), as the CFO guided on 20 May
checkpoints.ifMet: The first-year guidance as a listed company is delivered
checkpoints.ifMissed: The guide was too high for the order book

checkpoints.text: FY27 EBITDA margin of 12–13% (company basis excludes other income, the same as Screener's) and net profit at 8–9% of sales, as guided
checkpoints.ifMet: Margins hold even as it bids outside Gujarat
checkpoints.ifMissed: New states and larger jobs are being won on price

checkpoints.text: Financial close for the NOPL solar project: the CFO expected the IREDA or Union Bank-led loan (about 75% of a ₹4,000–4,200cr project) to be sanctioned and disbursed in the September quarter
checkpoints.ifMet: The project can be built without straining the EPC business
checkpoints.ifMissed: Vikran must keep funding a project far larger than itself from its own cash and short-term loans

checkpoints.text: Debtor days falling from FY26's 296, which the CFO called the peak, with some improvement visible in the half-year results and a substantial fall by March 2027
checkpoints.ifMet: Collections, including Jal Jeevan Mission water dues (about ₹120cr), are finally coming in
checkpoints.ifMissed: Profits keep piling up as unpaid bills

checkpoints.text: FY27 standalone revenue of ₹2,200–2,500cr, of which about ₹1,500cr from building its own NOPL solar project (₹100cr in September, ₹1,400cr in H2), at a 14–17% EBITDA margin; consolidated revenue will exclude the NOPL work, so this is judged on the standalone figures
checkpoints.ifMet: Execution is on plan, though most of the growth is work for its own subsidiary
checkpoints.ifMissed: The NOPL build or the rest of the order book is slipping

checkpoints.text: All 969 MW of the NOPL solar project commissioned within about 12 months of August 2026 (45 MW was running then), selling power to MSEDCL under a 25-year agreement
checkpoints.ifMet: About ₹525cr a year of power sales at very high margins starts to repay the project debt
checkpoints.ifMissed: Interest costs build up on a half-finished project

checkpoints.text: IPO money used as promised: ₹215cr to repay the company's loans and ₹30cr for its subsidiaries' loans (none spent by 30 September 2026), leaving the group close to debt-free. No call yet; this is from the RHP and the Q2 results.
checkpoints.ifMet: Interest costs, ₹39cr in FY26, mostly disappear and profit rises
checkpoints.ifMissed: The new money sits idle or is diverted

checkpoints.text: Domestic sales keep growing about 18–20% (Q2 FY27 domestic revenue rose 18%; the chairman's H1 message cited more than 20% excluding Simola) while exports recover from fuel and freight disruption
checkpoints.ifMet: The brand and dealer push is working
checkpoints.ifMissed: Q2 was a rebound from April's fuel shutdown, not a trend

checkpoints.text: The new Tezpur, Assam plant (Allemby Ceramics, about 50% owned, with about 1% more to be bought this year to make it a subsidiary) ramping up, and the shut Solaris ceramic plant being converted to glazed vitrified tiles, as set out in the H1 presentation
checkpoints.ifMet: East and Northeast sales, only about 14% of FY26 domestic tile revenue, start to grow
checkpoints.ifMissed: Capacity sits idle and returns stay low

checkpoints.text: Net debt about ₹800cr or less at March 2027 after the Vietnam buying season
A decision on the next freeze-dried line (about 6,000 t) announced, with its place and cost
Loan book near ₹7,000cr by March 2027 with bad loans (90+ days unpaid) still nil
Pre-tax profit of about ₹300cr for FY27, as guided (₹150cr in H1)
The first of the 12 project-finance borrowers starts commercial operation (6–9 months from the October 2026 call)
Monthly revenue run-rate above ₹90cr by March 2027 (₹75.1cr in September) as the second B200 lot fills
YouTube Shorts renewal signed (management now expects it in Q3)
Almond Drops unit volume still growing after the Q3 price rise of about 5% (half through smaller packs)
Debt-free by December 2026 (Q3 FY27), as now promised
Bandhavgarh opens by the end of calendar 2027 (new date from the Q2 FY27 call)
New ethoxylation unit well used once Reliance supplies more ethylene oxide (new date from the Q2 FY27 call)
Net debt below ₹200cr by March 2027 as cash goes to debt reduction (19 Oct 2026 call)
Gross margin back above 31% as the October price rise sticks (29.0% in Q2)
checkpoints.ifMet: Wait can end

checkpoints.text: Housing.com profitable within 12–18 months, as promised on the 16 Oct 2026 call
Margin on total assets above Q2’s 3.16%, as management says Q2 was the bottom
New CEO Anup Bagchi sets out his plan for deposits, liquidity cover and growth to analysts
Solar pumps growing again in H2 FY27 as PM-KUSUM 2.0 orders arrive, after slowing in Q2
Greenfield plant for fans, appliances and wires decided and costed (evaluation in advanced stages in October 2026)
FY27 revenue growth within the raised 15–18% guide
Receivable days back to 65–70 from 80 at September, as management expects within two quarters
H2 FY27 revenue growth above 30%, as guided in the Q2 call
Operating margin back in double digits from Q1 FY28, as promised after the FY27 guide cut to about 9%
Working capital below 140 days (153 at September 2026)
Ibuprofen review concluded (multi-product conversion or sale), as now promised for about mid-January 2027
Stock back to normal levels by March 2027, as promised in the Q2 call
Chiyada component plants (bushings, pressboard, conductor) in commercial operation, as the 27 Oct 2026 release now says
FY27 volume about 1.6 lakh tonnes (raised target; 1.33 lakh in FY26)
Chennai output 37,000–38,000 t in FY27
Steel-cord line running at good use
Thailand expansion (+50,000 t) up and running
Operating margin stays above 15% in H2 FY27, as management promised on the Q2 call
Full 5,300 t of anthraquinone and carbazole commissioned in one go
Operating cash positive for FY27 after −₹154cr in H1
Operating margin back above 15% in Q4 FY27 (14.4% in Q2), as US and Middle East margins improve from Q3
Cash and liquid funds rebuilt above ₹309cr (the June level) by March as inventory eases (about ₹211cr at September)
Gross bad loans stay below 1% as H1 FY27's 77% jump in lending seasons (0.66% at September)
Net interest margin closes FY27 at about 6%, as guided on the Q2 call
New line starts production (after Diwali, as now promised)
Q3 FY27 revenue of at least ₹3,021cr, the part of the order book scheduled for the quarter
FY27 exports of ₹90–100cr (cut from ₹105–110cr; ₹43cr in H1)
The EU audit held in FY27, as now expected
Operating margin back above 12% in Q3 FY27 as price rises catch up with steel costs (11% in Q1 and Q2)
checkpoints.ifMissed: Moves from own to follow

checkpoints.text: FY27 revenue growth of about 15% (about 10% in volume), as guided on the first call if exports revive
Northeast (Tezpur) plant at about 75% use in Q3 FY27 (50% in Q2)
Gujarat plant in production (from April 2027, as now promised)
Operating margin back to at least 10.5% in Q3 FY27 (guide 10–11%; Q2 was 9.9%)
checkpoints.ifMet: Q2 was the order mix, as management says
checkpoints.ifMissed: A second quarter near 10% points to price pressure; the Top 12 trigger is below 9.5% for two quarters

checkpoints.text: FY27 company-adjusted EBITDA margin of 25–26%, as raised in the Q2 call
checkpoints.ifMet: Stays own
checkpoints.ifMissed: The raise leaned on the rupee

checkpoints.text: South Africa 9,000 t crumb line running, after a 3–4 month slip
Durgapur tile-adhesive plant (9,000 t a month) running
